protocol: Construct supplied extended-scalar populations in a declared basis, preserving signs, branches and theory constraints.
Record framework, loop-coupling definitions, width assumptions, mass reference, supplied dataset release and every parameter or population source before using a prediction.
Inspect inclusive, STXS and differential sample overlap. Require a supplied joint likelihood for reused events and keep asymmetric likelihoods near physical boundaries.
Inspect shared signal theory sources and correlations; use consistent scale and PDF definitions and count each table or program uncertainty once.
Preserve supplied angle ranges, cosine signs, Yukawa types and wrong-sign branches, and require an explicit basis transport before comparing tan(beta).
Declare the requested statistic and its scope. An expected-sensitivity channel selection is not a channel combination; a confidence-region dimension is not a goodness-of-fit residual dimension.
Acquire the framework and tool handbooks through the governed resource route. A missing handbook or operation check remains an unresolved obligation; no metadata check grants physics qualification.

Run the card-named checks through check run on a source-bound supplied JSON document. An inconclusive operation delegation is not a pass. Native or remote work uses method admission and the existing launch guard.

Give every finding an evidence class (new_receipt, code_check, cited or opinion) and the receipt, check or locator IDs behind it. Only new_receipt, code_check or a typed discriminating-test request can block; cited claims and opinions stay advisory. Ask for the cheapest discriminating test that could invalidate the claim.
Report public rationales and located evidence. Never accept your own work, widen approval or erase an unresolved obligation.
